meta.title: VCACE | Vietnam–Australia Cultural Experiences & Exchange
meta.description: VCACE connects Vietnam and Australia through culture, bringing people together through experiences, dialogue, creative learning and bilateral exchange.

hero.headline: Connecting cultures.
hero.subheadline: Bringing Vietnam and Australia together through culture.
hero.intro: VCACE is an Australia-based bilateral cultural initiative connecting people, ideas and institutions through cultural experiences, dialogue, education and exchange.
hero.imageAlt: Two men hang long hand-printed woodcut scrolls in yellow, black, orange, white and green on the wall of a timber hall.
hero.imageCredit: Concept image · Photo: Bernd Dittrich / Unsplash

vision.headline: Culture connects people, and creates new possibilities.
paragraphs: We envision a stronger Vietnam–Australia relationship enriched by shared cultural understanding, creative collaboration and lasting people-to-people connections. VCACE works across contemporary arts, music, film, performing arts, food, heritage, cultural education and living traditions.

Through partnerships, we create spaces to experience culture, exchange perspectives and develop work that crosses borders. We bring together artists, educators, communities and institutions to curate public experiences, facilitate dialogue, develop learning opportunities and connect collaborators across both countries.

values.title: Mutual understanding
values.text: We make room for Vietnamese and Australian perspectives and genuine two-way learning.

values.title: Collaboration
values.text: We create with practitioners and partners, not simply for audiences.

values.title: Contemporary relevance
values.text: We connect living traditions with today’s ideas, identities and creative practices.

values.title: Inclusion
values.text: We welcome diverse communities and make culture accessible across generations.

programs.headline: Programs
programs.intro: Explore shared culture through four complementary pathways.

items.title: Cultural Experiences
items.text: Immersive experiences that bring culture to life.
items.examples: Exhibitions, music, dance, film, food, craft, movement and heritage encounters.
items.imageAlt: Three dancers in flowing coral dresses leap in unison on a stage lit pink and violet.
items.imageCredit: Concept image · Photo: Rojan Maharjan / Unsplash (unsplash.com/photos/j-7qHj6_GKs)

items.title: Cultural Dialogues
items.text: Conversations that deepen understanding between Vietnam and Australia.
items.examples: Public talks, artist conversations, panels, and dialogue with academics and cultural institutions.
items.imageAlt: A panel of speakers sits on a small stage, seen from behind the audience.
items.imageCredit: Concept image · Photo: Zac Bowling / Unsplash (unsplash.com/photos/Gi-HOiLMx7o)

items.title: Cultural Exchange
items.text: Connecting people and organisations across borders to create and learn together.
items.examples: Visiting practitioners, residencies, collaborative productions, studio visits, study and professional exchange.
items.imageAlt: Two street artists in Hội An, one folding palm-leaf flowers and one painting calligraphy scrolls on a mat.
items.imageCredit: Concept image · Photo: Alisa Kreydina / Unsplash

items.title: Cultural Education
items.text: Sharing knowledge, skills and perspectives through creative learning.
items.examples: Workshops, masterclasses, cultural literacy, school programs, digital stories and research-informed resources.
items.imageAlt: Clay-covered hands shape a bowl on a spinning pottery wheel.
items.imageCredit: Concept image · Photo: Monika Bienert / Unsplash

people.headline: People & Partners
people.partnersIntro: Organisations we work with to bring cultural programs to life.

collaborate.headline: Cultural exchange is built together.
paragraphs: VCACE welcomes conversations with anyone interested in meaningful Vietnam–Australia cultural collaboration.

groups.title: For individuals
groups.text: Artists, practitioners, event supporters and volunteers: tell us about yourself and how you would like to be involved. Send us a message through the form and we will be in touch.

groups.title: For organisations
groups.text: Institutions, community organisations, new partners, sponsors and donors: talk to us about co-creating a program, hosting an experience or supporting our activities.

footer.legalHostLine: VCACE is a centre of SEA Effect Australia
footer.acknowledgement: VCACE acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of Country throughout Australia, and their continuing connection to land, waters and community. We pay our respect to all First Nations peoples, to their cultures, and to their Elders, past, present and emerging.
